copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the correctness of a golden build

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你查 golden_man 命令行工具的用法:命令语法、可用选项和常见调用示例。内容覆盖 3 篇 man page(Git 2 篇、Curl 1 篇),以及 git-diff、git-log、gitk 等关联命令。
howto.when: 当 description 指定的 man golden build 测试场景,或你需要查命令语法、选项、调用示例时触发,如 Git、Curl 等。

say.text: git log 怎么用?给我语法和常用选项
say.note: 会返回 git log 的用法与选项说明

say.text: 给我一个 curl 抓取网页的命令示例
say.note: 返回 curl 取页示例

say.text: 看看 git-log 的 SEE ALSO 里有哪些相关命令

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude looks up how to use golden_man command-line tools: syntax, options, and example invocations. It covers 3 man pages (Git 2, Curl 1) plus related commands like git-diff, git-log, and gitk.
howto.when_en: Triggers when testing the man golden build, or when you need command syntax, options, or example invocations (Git, Curl, etc.).

say_en.text: How do I use git log? Give me the syntax and common options.
say_en.note: Returns git log usage and flags

say_en.text: Show me a curl example that fetches a page.
What related commands does git-log list under SEE ALSO?
